thesis: The podcast discusses the origin story of Lil Miquela, a virtual influencer created in 2016 by the company Bread to tell fictional narratives on social media platforms. The founders aimed to create a photo-realistic human avatar to avoid the 'uncanny valley' and resonate with audiences accustomed to non-fiction social media, drawing inspiration from internet culture and the success of shows like Will & Grace.
